specs.parallel:
# Parallel fixture specification

Status: APPROVED

Create exact UTF-8 text files `out/p1.txt` containing `P1\n` and `out/p2.txt` containing `P2\n`. P1 and P2 have no dependencies, disjoint read/write scopes, no generated-output aliases, and no shared mutable resources. A fast plan must use strategy parallel, safe concurrency limit 2, and first wave P1+P2 with a main-agent barrier. Default build executes only that safe wave. No external writes, network, fees, commit, push, install, or deployment.
specs.serial:
# Serial fixture specification

Status: APPROVED

Create exact UTF-8 text files `out/shared/p1.txt` containing `S1\n` and `out/shared/p2.txt` containing `S2\n`. S1 and S2 have no business dependency, but S1 declares write scope `out/shared/`, S2 declares write scope `out/shared/p2.txt`, and both use shared mutable resource `fixture-shared-lock`. A fast plan must remain serial with safe concurrency limit 1 and record both collision reasons. Build auto may complete both only in order, never concurrently. No external writes, network, fees, commit, push, install, or deployment.
specs.partial:
# Partial-wave fixture specification

Status: APPROVED

P1 creates exact UTF-8 `out/p1.txt` containing `P1\n`; P2 creates exact UTF-8 `out/p2.txt` containing `P2\n`; P3 creates exact UTF-8 `out/p3.txt` containing `P3\n` and depends on completion of the full P1+P2 wave barrier. The supplied immutable plan and todo intentionally represent P1 completed, P2 pending, and P3 pending/frozen. Default build must not rerun P1, must execute only P2, and must stop at the barrier without executing P3. No external writes, network, fees, commit, push, install, or deployment.
specs.default:
# Default serial fixture specification

Status: APPROVED

D1 creates exact UTF-8 `out/d1.txt` containing `D1\n`; D2 creates `out/d2.txt` containing `D2\n` and depends on D1; D3 creates `out/d3.txt` containing `D3\n` and depends on D2. Ordinary plan must not enable fast. Default build completes only D1 and stops; the later explicit build auto completes D2 then D3 serially. No external writes, network, fees, commit, push, install, or deployment.

partialPlan:
# Partial-wave immutable plan

Planning basis: approved `work-products/SPEC.md`; objective, scope, constraints, acceptance, safety, and rollback are complete.

- Execution strategy: parallel
- Fast requested: yes
- Safe concurrency limit: 2
- Serial reason: none

## P1

- Objective and acceptance: create `out/p1.txt` with exact `P1\n`.
- Dependencies: none
- Read scope: `work-products/SPEC.md`
- Write scope: `out/p1.txt`
- Generated outputs: none
- Shared mutable resources: none
- Focused validation: exact UTF-8 content check; parallel-safe yes
- Failure retention and rollback: retain evidence; remove only P1 output
- Wave and start condition: W1; pending and write baseline unchanged
- Main-agent integration: verify receipt and exact diff

## P2

- Objective and acceptance: create `out/p2.txt` with exact `P2\n`.
- Dependencies: none
- Read scope: `work-products/SPEC.md`
- Write scope: `out/p2.txt`
- Generated outputs: none
- Shared mutable resources: none
- Focused validation: exact UTF-8 content check; parallel-safe yes
- Failure retention and rollback: retain evidence; remove only P2 output
- Wave and start condition: W1; pending and write baseline unchanged
- Main-agent integration: verify receipt and exact diff

## P3

- Objective and acceptance: create `out/p3.txt` with exact `P3\n`.
- Dependencies: P1, P2 and W1 barrier
- Read scope: `out/p1.txt`, `out/p2.txt`
- Write scope: `out/p3.txt`
- Generated outputs: none
- Shared mutable resources: none
- Focused validation: exact UTF-8 content check; parallel-safe no
- Failure retention and rollback: retain evidence; remove only P3 output
- Wave and start condition: W2; W1 barrier passed
- Main-agent integration: verify W1 barrier before unlock

## Waves

- W1 ready tasks: P1, P2; frozen tasks: P3; barrier: validate both receipts and exact outputs; unlock: only after P1 and P2 completed.
- W2 ready tasks: none initially; frozen tasks: P3; barrier: final exact-output check; unlock: W1 barrier passed.
